name: the-distillation
purpose: Trains a small AI model only on its own working that exact arithmetic verified, then measures it cold (one try, no checker) on problems it never saw. The trained weights are kept only if it is right more often and no more confidently wrong, and a later round starts from them only when a person grants it. Every round is sealed and can be judged again from its records.

lane.accepts: a calculation and a reply of worked steps ending in ANSWER: n, offered as a training example
lane.refuses: anything that is not an exact calculation: there is no check for it, so nothing can be verified or trained on

interface.out: verified when every line is one step and exactly true and the answer is the calculation's own; unverified when any line or the answer is not; refused when what is asked is not a calculation

judge.what: a reply may be trained on only when every line of its working is a single true step and its answer is the calculation's own
